description: Machine-readable Level Factory visual-contract descriptor. Propagates the already owner-locked SCRUBBOTS visual contract (root docs/08_PIXEL_ART_PALETTE_RULES.md + data/palettes/scrubbots_palette_v1.json) into Level Factory governance. This descriptor is NOT a second palette authority.

paletteAuthority.note: The root palette JSON is the single source of truth for C01..C16. This descriptor never redefines those colors; if any duplication ever conflicts, the root palette wins.
forbidden: any off-palette logical artwork RGB value

difficultyDistinctUsedColorBands.note: Count only distinct canonical logical cell colors actually used by artwork cells. Hard production legality, not a heuristic score.

gameplayBackground.name: Midnight Slate
gameplayBackground.semantics: Production gameplay surface behind the artwork; visible through CLEARED alpha-0 cells. Never appears as a LevelData cell color.
gameplayBackground.note: BG01 is outside C01..C16; it is not a logical artwork color.

cellStateSemantics.ACTIVE: Original canonical source color (one of C01..C16), opaque.
cellStateSemantics.CLEARED: Fully transparent, alpha 0; BG01 shows through.
cellStateSemantics.note: Runtime lifecycle only; CLEARED is not a palette color (ADR-019).

cellRenderContract.note: Visible cell separation is presentation-only and does not create logical colors or count toward difficulty totals. Cell interiors are one flat solid canonical palette color.

generatorGuards.note: Future Level Factory generator/validator/exporter code MUST enforce these; documentation guards until code exists. No generator implementation is created by META-C005.
